title: 第15章崖壁攀行第16章拔钉
slug: 矿奴开局八极拳打穿三十六重天
content_zh:
柳晴站在苏意身后，白衣在夜风里飘。
竖瞳映着火光，手里骨珠手串一颗一颗转着，人骨碰撞的声音很轻，像牙齿打颤。
“第一场还没完，你去哪？”
苏意没回话。
他侧过头扫了一眼——吴长老已经从裂成两半的擂台方向走过来，步子不快，但每一步落地，脚底下的碎石就自动滚到两边，像给他让路。
缩地术的余韵还在空气里荡着，筑基九层的灵压把地上的尘土压成一片平滑的灰毯子。
然后吴长老停了。
他没有追到崖壁下，而是站在三十丈外，双手结印。
十根手指在月光下翻了一串苏意看不懂的印诀，指尖每动一下，崖壁就震一下。
“石偶咒。”赵老蔫的声音从头顶传下来，沙哑得像砂纸磨在铁锈上，“他炼化了整面崖壁！”
崖壁活了。
岩石表面像水面被搅动一样泛起涟漪，一圈一圈往外扩散。
涟漪中心长出东西——先是五根手指，然后是掌心，然后是手臂。
石头变成的手从崖壁里伸出来，一只，十只，一百只。
大大小小，密密麻麻，整面山崖像地狱里的冤魂在同时往外爬。
石掌的指节嘎嘎作响，那是岩石挤压岩石的声音，听着像骨头被人一根一根掰断。
苏意已经开始攀了。
他冲出去的那一刻就没打算停。
脚蹬地面，整个人拔起来三丈，双手扣进崖壁的第一道岩缝。
熬骨境巅峰的指力在岩缝里留下十个指洞。

左脚踩稳一块凸起的岩石，右脚本能地往上够——前世爬高层没电梯的老楼送快递，腿自己就知道怎么蹬。
三十米。
脚下忽然一紧。
两只石掌从崖壁里伸出来，攥住了他的脚踝。
石掌的力量不是挤压，是绞。
像两条石头做的蟒蛇同时缠上脚踝，越收越紧。
脚踝骨骼发出咯吱声——不是骨裂的声音，是骨密度三倍于常人的骨头在抵抗石掌绞杀时发出的摩擦声。
苏意低头看了一眼。
石掌的五指完全贴合他的脚踝，指节陷进皮肉里半寸。
铁线臂能护住手臂，但护不住脚踝，皮肉被石指的边缘割破，血顺着脚背淌进石缝。
他试着往上拔。
石掌纹丝不动。
再拔。
石掌反而收得更紧。
脚踝处的血液循环被截断，脚掌开始发麻。
不能慌。
脑子里回闪过一个画面——前世，工地，拆旧楼。
脚踩进钢筋笼子的缝隙里，拔不出来。
工友拿钢锯锯了十分钟才把钢筋锯断。
content_en:
Liu Qing stood behind Su Yi, her white clothes fluttering in the night wind.
The vertical pupils reflected the firelight, and the bone beads bracelet in his hand was spinning one by one. The sound of the collision of human bones was very soft, like the chattering of teeth.
"The first scene isn't over yet, where are you going?"
Su Yi didn't reply.
He turned his head and glanced sideways - Elder Wu had already walked towards the ring that was split in half. His steps were not fast, but with every step he took, the gravel under his feet automatically rolled to both sides, as if to make way for him.
The afterglow of the Shuchi Jutsu was still lingering in the air, and the spiritual pressure from the ninth level of the foundation pressed the dust on the ground into a smooth gray blanket.
Then Elder Wu stopped.
He did not chase him to the bottom of the cliff, but stood thirty feet away, forming a seal with his hands.
Ten fingers turned over a series of seals that Su Yi could not understand under the moonlight. Every time the fingertips moved, the cliff shook.
"Stone Doll Curse." Zhao Laowen's voice came from above his head, hoarse like sandpaper rubbed against rust, "He refined the entire cliff!"
The cliff comes alive.
Ripples appeared on the rock surface like water being stirred, spreading outward in circles.
Something grew in the center of the ripples—first five fingers, then the palm, then the arm.
Hands turned from stone stretched out from the cliff, one, ten, or a hundred.
Large and small, densely packed, the entire cliff looks like the souls of the guilty in hell crawling out at the same time.
The knuckles of the stone palm rattled, which was the sound of rocks squeezing against rocks. It sounded like bones being broken one by one.
Su Yi has already started climbing.
The moment he rushed out, he had no intention of stopping.
Pushing his feet on the ground, he lifted up three feet and dug his hands into the first crevice of the cliff.
The finger strength at the peak of the bone-burning realm left ten finger holes in the rock crevices.
The left foot stepped firmly on a raised rock, and the right leg instinctively reached up. In my previous life, I climbed up to an old building with no elevator to deliver express delivery, so my legs knew how to push on their own.
Thirty meters.
My feet suddenly tightened.
Two stone palms stretched out from the cliff and grabbed his ankles.
The power of the stone palm is not to squeeze, but to twist.
Like two pythons made of stone, they wrapped around their ankles at the same time, tightening them tighter and tighter.
The ankle bones made a creaking sound - not the sound of bone cracking, but the friction sound of bones with bone density three times that of ordinary people as they resisted being strangled by stone palms.
Su Yi lowered his head and glanced.
The five fingers of Stone Palm fit perfectly into his ankle, and the knuckles sunk half an inch into the flesh.
The wire arms could protect the arms, but not the ankles. The skin and flesh were cut by the edges of the stone fingers, and blood flowed down the insteps into the cracks in the stones.
He tried to pull up.
Shizhang was motionless.
Pull out again.
Instead, the stone palm tightened even more.
The blood circulation in the ankles was cut off, and the soles of the feet began to feel numb.
Don't panic.
A picture flashed through my mind - a previous life, a construction site, demolishing an old building.
My feet got stuck in the cracks of the steel cage and I couldn't pull them out.
The worker took a hacksaw for ten minutes before cutting the steel bars.
